name: vn.datacore/datacore-a2a
title: DataCore A2A
description: Normalise Vietnamese addresses and look up companies by name or tax code, through DataCore A2A.

environmentVariables.name: DATACORE_A2A_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the DataCore gateway, for example https://gateway.datacore.vn. It must be the gateway — pointing straight at the orchestrator is always rejected with 401.

environmentVariables.name: DATACORE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Long-lived credential shaped dck_..., created with POST /mcp/credentials — see the README. The server exchanges it for short-lived mandates and refreshes them itself, so it never has to be replaced on expiry. Either this or DATACORE_MANDATE is required.

environmentVariables.name: DATACORE_MANDATE
environmentVariables.description: A hand-issued AP2 mandate, the older way. Not refreshed: when it expires you replace it and restart. Use it only if you were set up this way; otherwise use DATACORE_API_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: DATACORE_SKILLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated skill ids to narrow the tools that get exposed, or * for every skill the endpoint returns. Empty uses the default four.

environmentVariables.name: DATACORE_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in seconds. Defaults to 30.
